task_name: Build and Extend a Road Connected to the Existing Street

steps.who: Industrial / Factories icon (top-right slot of the bottom-right menu panel with a '1' badge)
steps.briefing: If prompted by the tutorial to build a Factory first, click the Industrial icon in the top-right slot of the bottom-right menu panel.

steps.who: Small Factory icon from the bottom construction bar onto open green grass directly adjacent to the existing horizontal road
steps.briefing: Drag the Small Factory from the bottom bar onto the open grass just north of the existing horizontal road between the two houses.

steps.who: floating green checkmark button above the placed Small Factory preview
steps.briefing: Click the floating green checkmark button to confirm placing the Small Factory.

steps.who: Small Factory building with the 'Z' sleeping icon above it on the north side of the horizontal road
steps.briefing: Click the newly placed Small Factory building (where the tutorial hand points) to open its production menu.

steps.who: Metal icon (grey steel I-beam in the bottom-left production bar) onto the Small Factory building in the center of the screen
steps.briefing: Drag the Metal icon from the bottom production bar up onto the Small Factory to start forging Metal and clear the tutorial lock.

steps.who: Roads icon (top-left slot of the bottom-right menu panel, showing a grey road segment with yellow dashed lines)
steps.briefing: Click the Roads icon in the top-left corner of the bottom-right menu panel to open the road construction tool.

steps.who: road drawing cursor from the eastern end of the existing horizontal road southward into the open green grass
steps.briefing: Drag from the eastern end of the existing horizontal road (around x=1380, y=505) downward/southward into the open green grass (around x=1380, y=750) to draw a new connected road segment.

steps.who: floating green checkmark button beside the drawn road preview
steps.briefing: Click the floating green checkmark button beside the drawn road preview to confirm and build the road segment.

steps.who: blue 'X' close button in the bottom-right corner
steps.briefing: Click the blue 'X' button in the bottom-right corner of the screen to exit road construction mode.

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the player manually requests to build a road or when existing road frontage is full and additional connected road segments are needed to place new residential, commercial, industrial, or service buildings.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: All buildings in SimCity BuildIt require direct connection to the highway via a continuous road network. Extending the road creates new buildable frontage for factories, utilities, and residential zones while allowing polluting buildings to be placed farther away from homes.
preconditions: Roads icon available in the bottom-right menu panel (two-lane roads are free to construct)
Unobstructed land adjacent to the existing road network
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Start dragging from an existing road segment (such as the eastern end of the main horizontal road) into open grass so the new road connects directly to the city's highway-linked road network.
